data.body: Phase 1 (retroactive review): COMPLETE. Pushed 3 existing local story branches (aead-ae88, 35b8-abe6, 0652-809a) + 1 retroactive branch (retroactive-da45-7d92) to origin. All 4 Sprint Story Review CI runs fired successfully — confirming the trigger pattern works once branches are pushed. 3 historical runs returned 'failure' status (expected — actual LLM findings against 74 previously-unreviewed commits). Retroactive run in progress. Findings from CI runs are separate concern, not part of this bug's scope. Bug scope = trigger gap, which is now resolved for this sprint. Phases 2+3 next.
